explanation: This component fires only at D1 in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 94 to 99), and only when the previous trial reached S1 and was rewarded (common or rare transition, either choice). Then it is 8-10, rising slightly toward trial 99; it is 0 at every other step, and at every step earlier in the episode, apart from about 1 for a rewarded S1 around trial 70-75.
